query: We keep repeating the same accessibility review in chat. Can you codify how to run it, what to inspect, and the proof that closes the review in an agent skill?

My Agents Skills catalog and the packaged copy of our triage skill disagree. Compare the actual bundles and retain the useful workflow steps from each.
Our onboarding skill finishes after opening the dashboard even when the check failed. Add an explicit stop rule and cases for a false pass and a renamed passing check.
Our reusable spreadsheet playbook fell out of WinDAGs graft results after a rewrite. Verify its routing with fresh user phrasing and refresh the examples in the search index.
Test whether this SKILL.md really makes the assistant catch missing test receipts. Compare runs without the playbook, with the old version, and with my revision.
Build an MCP server for our calendars. I need TypeScript tools for availability and event creation.
Use our existing accessibility audit checklist to inspect this checkout page and report the keyboard issues.
Audit the skills section of my resume and help me show that I can lead a software team.
Debug why my deployment worker exits during application startup after the database connection succeeds.
